title: Championship Knockout Fixtures Released: Basketball & Volleyball
content: Official tournament knockout brackets and court allocation timetables for the Men's & Women's Basketball and Volleyball divisions are now ratified by the referee panel. All team managers must report to the Physical Education Pavilion 30 minutes prior to tip-off.
venue: Outdoor Sports Complex — Courts A & B
instructions: College Identity Card & Official Eligibility Undertaking mandatory
Teams must be present in matching jersey kit colors with numbers
Coin toss takes place 15 minutes before scheduled match time

title: Classical & Folk Dance Arena Stage Setup & Sound Check Notice
content: Acoustic calibration and stage lighting checks for Classical Solo and Group Dance participants will commence at 08:30 AM in the Silver Jubilee Auditorium. Audio tracks must be submitted via USB drive in MP3 format to the sound engineers.
venue: Silver Jubilee Auditorium — Main Proscenium Stage
instructions: Audio track submission deadline: 09:00 AM at AV control desk
Maximum performance duration: 8 minutes with 2 minutes setup
Green rooms allocated in Block-IV ground floor

title: Grand Valedictory Ceremony & Overall Championship Trophy Presentation
content: The 40th Inter-Collegiate Meet Closing Ceremony will be presided over by the College President and visiting dignitaries at the Open Air Theatre. Overall Institutional Championship Rolling Trophies and individual gold laurels will be conferred.
instructions: All college contingents must assemble by 04:30 PM
Award winners must be in official college attire for podium ceremony
Digital certificates will be available immediately post-ceremony

title: Complimentary Campus Shuttle & Cafeteria Timings for Visiting Contingents
content: Dedicated transport shuttles will run between Guntur Railway Station / RTC Bus Terminal and RVRJCCE Campus from 06:00 AM onwards. Breakfast and lunch coupons are distributed at the Registration Helpdesk near Gate 1.
venue: Campus Reception Desk & Student Dining Hall
instructions: Present event e-pass at helpdesk to receive accommodation tokens
Hostel wardens available 24/7 for inter-district guest support
